summary: FiEE, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on November 6, 2026, furnished with a press release dated the same day. The filing announces completion of the company's international art exhibition and special auction in Kyoto, Japan, held October 23-25, 2026; the auction drew nearly 400 online and in-person participants and produced roughly US$2.9 million in aggregate artwork transaction value, of which FiEE recognized about US$1.3 million in service revenue. No securities, ownership, price-per-share, or corporate-transaction terms are stated. The event is an ordinary business operations update, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor apply. Watch for execution on the stated plan to run recurring art events as an O2O ArtTech revenue line.
